observations: The heavy form retains the exact standing camera, boot positions, face and white/red hair. Outer shoulder, forearm, hip and shin layers hinge outward and expose purple-lit underlying mechanical joints. Broad chest plates and open headpiece remain. Two wrists connect to unchanged curled gloves; both legs and full boots present. No new gun or armor silhouette unrelated to the layered heavy form. Small plate rotations and gaps read as opening; fingers inspected enlarged.
